title:
POV: I BOUGHT A BIKE FOR A MAN
IN JAMAICA 🇯🇲 WHO LOST HIS HOME
beats: OPEN: 'Look at the situation, how people here are living right now here in Jamaica. This is reality, completely homeless. Having to sleep here where they put the animals.'
'This is where this family is living right now. This is where they store pigs and animals — and they're living here.'
'this family of 10 people completely lost their home ... you can see the baby sleeping on old mattresses'
'First time I was here, I cried.'
HOOK: 'What's your dream for your birthday?'
'...see if I could get a bicycle' / 'A bicycle?' / 'Okay, let's make that happen' -> HIS REPLY 'That would be really great, man'
'alright guys, we'll be back with the bicycle'
IN THE CAR — HIS STORY: 'my story is ... the hurricane ... three YEARS to build ... in a minute it's all gone'
'...and I really appreciate it. And I just, I miss my home.'
'This is what life's about, helping people ... you lost everything, someone came to help you, and then you gotta help someone else. That's how the world works.'
BIKE SHOP: 'we're buying him a bicycle' / 'matching your shirt?' / 'Yeah, man' — both smiling
'I want to write Damien.' — him bent over the frame, writing
PAYOFF for that line: 'What'd you write?' -> '33 ... my birthday.'
HIM USING IT: 'What do you think? New bike, who this?'
riding together: 'You know how to bike with two people?' ... 'Circle for now, man.'
PAYOFF: 'you bring like a FULL ENJOYMENT to my life right now' — V4 chopped this after 'a'
HIS MESSAGE (ending): 'Just continue. Do good. Leave negative thoughts. And let's be good in life, man.'
